title: Cover non-Windows startup-sweep child errors 5 and 32 as fatal
outcome: Add a non-Windows regression control proving that startup-sweep candidate child errors with raw OS codes 5 and 32 remain fatal, so accidentally removing cfg!(windows) from retain_denied_test_fixture cannot silently retain EIO/EPIPE failures on macOS/Linux. Existing Windows retention behavior stays as specified. No retries, waits or weakened assertions.
acceptance: Cover non-Windows startup-sweep child errors 5 and 32 as fatal is done
